description: For an actual index \(e\) total relative to \(A\), and supplied ordinary index \(a\), the specified function is \(m_{A,a,e}(n)=\max(k_e^A(n),\tau_a(k_e^A(n)))\), where \(k_e^A(n)\) is the least successful allowance and \(\tau_a\) is the existing least-settling-stage function for \(W_a\).
